exercises.instruction: Which do you prefer? Write sentences using ‘I prefer (something) to (something else)’. Now rewrite sentences 3 and 4 using rather than:

answers: I prefer driving to travelling by train.

items.prompt: (going to the cinema / watching movies at home)
answers: I prefer going to the cinema to watching movies at home.

items.prompt: (being very busy / having nothing to do)
answers: I prefer being very busy to having nothing to do.
I prefer to drive rather than travel by train.
I prefer driving rather than travelling by train.

items.cue: Now say sentence 3 again with rather than: the cinema, or films at home.
answers: I prefer to go to the cinema rather than watch movies at home.
I prefer going to the cinema rather than watching movies at home.

items.cue: Now say sentence 4 again with rather than: being busy, or having nothing to do.
answers: I prefer to be very busy rather than have nothing to do.
I prefer being very busy to having nothing to do.
